# shopapi (cloudspider-shopapi) v1.0.0

A sample backend on EKS: PostgREST over the shopdb database, with a migration Job that creates and seeds the schema.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| clusterName | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | cloudspider-up | the EKS cluster it runs on |
| dbSecret | must be a Kubernetes name | shopdb-app | the CNPG app secret |
| expose | none \| alb | none | none: ClusterIP; alb: internet-facing ALB (needs the lbc add-on) |
| replicas | 1..6 | 2 | pods, spread over zones |

## Outputs

- `namespace`
- `deployment`
- `migrationJob`
- `portForward`
- `exposed`
- `replicaCount`
- `url`

## Guarantees

- Providers pinned: `@pulumi/aws` 7.50.0, `@pulumi/kubernetes` 4.34.2, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- No data resources to protect.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.

See CHANGELOG.md.
